messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
et elle ne bougeait pas devant mon visage, au contraire elle entravait tant mon chemin, que je fus pour revenir plusieurs fois tourné.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Alignment Table (Italian → French)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **e** | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **et** | “and” | OK | | **non** | Negation adverb “not” | **ne** | “not” (part of French negation) | OK | | **mi** | 1st‑person singular clitic pronoun (dative) “to me” | – | – | **MISSING** | | **si** | Reflexive clitic pronoun (part of verb) | – | – | **MISSING** | | **partia** | Imperfect of *partire* “to move / depart” | **bougeait** | “was moving / was not moving” | OK | | **dinanzi** | Preposition “in front of, before” | **devant** | “in front of” | OK | | **al** | Contraction *a* + *il* “to the” (definite article) | **mon** | “my” (possessive replaces article) | OK | | **volto** | Noun “face” | **visage** | “face” | OK | | **anzi** | Adverb “instead, nay” | **au contraire** | “instead, nay” | OK | | **‘mpediva** (impediva) | Imperfect of *impedire* “to hinder” | **entravait** | “hindered” | OK | | **tanto** | Adverb of degree “so, to such an extent” | **tant** | “so” | OK | | **il** | Definite article “the” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (article not required in French) | | **mio** | Possessive adjective “my” | **mon** | “my” | OK | | **cammino** | Noun “road, path” | **chemin** | “road” | OK | | **ch’i’** (che + io) | Subordinating conjunction “that” | **que** | “that” | OK | | **fui** | Past historic of *essere* “was” | **fus** | “was” (auxiliary) | OK | | **per** | Preposition “for, in order to” | **pour** | “to / for” | OK | | **ritornar** | Infinitive “to return” | **revenir** | “to return” | OK | | **più** | Comparative adverb “more” (frequency) | **plusieurs** | “several” (quantifier) | OK | | **volte** | Noun “times” (frequency) | **fois** | “times” | OK | | **vòlto** | Past historic of *voltare* “turned” | **tourné** | “turned” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **MISSING**: *mi*, *si* – the dative “to me” and the reflexive marker are not expressed in the French rendering. - **UNNECESSARY**: *il* – the Italian definite article is not needed in French because the possessive *mon* already conveys the reference.
No **WRONG** or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected in the French translation.

(or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final French text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
